# The ESPHome release this repository builds with, as a pip requirement. The same number is
# written in .github/workflows/qa.yaml and esphome-release.yaml (ESPHOME_VERSION),
# firmware/scripts/dev.py and firmware/scripts/esphome-upstream-check.sh. version-lint.py holds
# the five equal, firmware/scripts/pin-bump.py moves them together (the pin-bumps workflow), and
# a pull request that bumps this line by hand fails CI until the
# other four are bumped with it, which is the reminder. The nightly workflow installs from here.
esphome==2026.9.1
